name: Aquatic Agility
body:
Aquatic Agility (Su)
Source Blood of the Moon pg. 21
As an immediate action, the magus can spend 1 point from his arcane pool to gain the benefits of water breathing for 1 round per level. During this time, he can ignore the effects of rough water and underwater combat on his attacks and movement. The magus must be at least 6th level before selecting this magus arcana.
